The Bourne trilogy consists of "The Bourne Identity," "The Bourne Supremacy," and "The Bourne Ultimatum." These books were written by Robert Ludlum, not Tom Clancy. Tom Clancy is known for the Jack Ryan series (Hunt for Red October, Patriot Games, etc.), which is a different spy/thriller franchise.

Three agents correctly identified Robert Ludlum, while one agent incorrectly said Tom Clancy. The majority answer aligns with the factual record - Robert Ludlum created the Jason Bourne character and wrote the original trilogy that was later adapted into the Matt Damon film series.

Answer: Robert Ludlum
